subject: Tenant entitlement seed + invite cadence — BetaHealth initial kickoff
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kelly <sarah.kelly@betahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Tenant entitlement seed + invite cadence — BetaHealth initial kickoff

Hi Sarah —

Great to meet you yesterday. Per our call, I wanted to put a concise starter plan in email so we have a shared checklist for the initial tenant setup and admin seeding. Goal is to have BetaHealth able to call the API from a sandbox project and provision one admin workspace by EOW next week. High level plan: 

1) Project / namespace creation (we will create a sandbox project + production project)
2) Admin entitlement seed (2 admin API keys and 1 service token)
3) Role mapping & initial RBAC (Admin, Dev, ReadOnly) — let us know the primary admin list
4) Invite cadence (we handle bulk invites for the first 10 users plus staggered invites thereafter)
5) KMS & key handling (do you want us to generate keys or will BetaHealth provide a customer KMS?)

Action items for BetaHealth: 
- Confirm 2 initial admin accounts (full name + email)
- Confirm whether SSO (SAML) is required for initial access or we proceed with email invites
- Provide an IP allowlist if you want the sandbox locked down immediately

Tentative timeline: 
- Today (Oct 7): confirm admin list + SSO/KMS preference
- Oct 8: we seed sandbox project and hand over admin API keys to your named admins
- Oct 9–11: initial invites + short validation call (30 mins)

I attached a one-page checklist and the mutual action plan template for quick edits. If this looks good I can seed keys once you confirm the admin emails and KMS approach.

Attachments: betahealth_onboard_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

—
Jordan Blake
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Sarah Kelly <sarah.kelly@betahealth.com>

Date: 2026-10-07T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant entitlement seed + invite cadence — BetaHealth initial kickoff

Thanks, Jordan — this is helpful. A few clarifications before we lock things in: 

- Admin seats: Please seed keys for 3 admins (myself sarah.kelly@betahealth.com, Evan Cho evan.cho@betahealth.com, and our infra lead infra+api@betahealth.com).
- SSO: We will enable SAML for production, but for the sandbox we prefer email invites to avoid the SSO ramp.
- KMS: We plan to use our own KMS (AWS KMS) for production. For the sandbox, please generate keys and we will rotate later.
- Procurement: looping in procurement@betahealth.com for billing/PO follow up — they may have a short vendor form.

Can you confirm the format you'll deliver admin API keys (encrypted file or secure upload)? Also any limitation on API key rotation cadence we should be aware of?

Regards,
Sarah Kelly
Director, Platform Engineering
BetaHealth

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant entitlement seed + invite cadence — BetaHealth initial kickoff

Hi Sarah — thanks for the fast reply and for confirming the admin list. We can proceed with the sandbox flow you outlined. A few implementation notes and answers to your questions: 

• Admin key delivery: we will publish the admin API keys to a secure S3 link that is encrypted and time-limited (24h expiry). We will notify the recipients and rotate the link if needed. Keys are generated server-side and we provide a one-time secret for each key; after receipt we recommend storing in your vault and rotating per your policy.

• Key rotation cadence: there is no enforced minimum; our recommendation is 90 days for production. For sandbox you can rotate sooner. API keys can be rotated via the Console or the Admin API; we will include steps in the handed-over doc.

• KMS: noted. For sandbox we will generate temporary keys and for production we will guide KMS integration with AWS KMS (we support key wrapping with customer-managed keys).

Updated timeline (minimal):
- Oct 8 (today): I will create sandbox project and seed the 3 admin keys to the emails you listed.
- Oct 9: Monica will send the initial invite batch (up to 10) and Ben will validate a sample token exchange from your infra team.
- Oct 12: 30-min validation call (confirm logs, quotas, and sample end-to-end generation).

Please confirm a short window for the Oct 12 validation call (I propose 11:00–11:30 PT). We also uploaded a draft mutual action plan to the shared drive — edit as you like and we'll finalize.

Attachments: BH_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.docx (draft)

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
